statusLine.command: input=$(cat); user=$(whoami); host=$(hostname -s); dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir // empty'); short_dir="${dir/#$HOME/~}"; model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name // empty'); repo=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.repo | if . then .owner + "/" + .name else empty end'); ctx=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.remaining_percentage // empty'); pr=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.pr.number // empty'); session=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.session_name // empty'); wt=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.worktree.name // empty'); parts=""; [ -n "$session" ] && parts="$parts $(printf '\033[35m%s\033[0m' "$session")"; [ -n "$wt" ] && parts="$parts $(printf '\033[90mwt:%s\033[0m' "$wt")"; parts="$parts $(printf '\033[1;33m%s\033[0m@\033[1;34m%s\033[0m' "$user" "$host") $(printf '\033[1;32m%s\033[0m' "$short_dir")"; [ -n "$repo" ] && parts="$parts $(printf '\033[90m(%s)\033[0m' "$repo")"; [ -n "$pr" ] && parts="$parts $(printf '\033[35mPR #%s\033[0m' "$pr")"; [ -n "$model" ] && parts="$parts $(printf '\033[36m%s\033[0m' "$model")"; [ -n "$ctx" ] && parts="$parts $(printf '\033[90mctx:%s%%\033[0m' "$ctx")"; echo "${parts# }"
